name: 25 (2026-11-25 late evening)
what: Track F: the passage chain has ended its segments, state and continuation; Track D: its last two G2 runs judged and the package assembled if complete
note: Releases core-v0.4 to v0.7 are on main. Rulings: coord/DECISIONS/0039 to 0043. After git merge main: nrpic-run finish closes runs continued in place; finish and verify keep a checksum cache (the first pass reads everything once: start it in the background and do not wait; one pass with --full before a gate review). The week's usage is tight (0040 item 5): keep to the time given, read what the task needs. Close a finished run before you analyse it; every number with its run id; prediction before every new run; figures made by registered scripts and looked at; at most 6 cores.

items.extra: Extra for this session (about an hour). The passage chain (queue entry q0001, run F-20261124-210400-902c650) has left the queue as done: it reached its segment cap or its end. (1) State: how far the passage is (in M), with your registered readers rerun (b21_a2_state.py, b11_passage.py) and figures looked at; judge A2-2 and your prediction of where the cap would stop it. (2) If the separation (at least 170 M) is not reached: continue the passage as ruling 0042 item 2 allows, through ONE wrapper entry of the shared queue at priority 2, within its 19.5 card-hours and up to five more from G1's allotment. Before that, ONE processor test on the build the chain uses that a restart with an extra input file (`-r <restart file> -i <file>` holding `<fastflow>` and `diagnostics = true`: decision 0043 item 5) starts, writes horizon_status files and leaves the other outputs of a few cycles identical; prediction first. If it passes, the continuation carries it, so that the verifier's finding F1 (the heavy black hole's mass on two branches from 86.6 M) can be decided from the status file; if it fails, continue without it and say so. Do this early in the session so that the entry is in the queue tonight. (3) The fresh verifier's report stage/G1/VERIFIER.md: apply its requests (a) to (d) (drifts labelled as fractions of the mass per M; no order of convergence claimed between the mesh members; the Newtonian pass of the centre of mass; the stored separation at 112 M checked), record F1 as open with the plan, and the junk-energy criterion as met at its edge. (4) Stage G1: collect, verify, report; say what G1 still lacks.

Extra for this session (about seventy-five minutes). Ended since your last session: queue entries q0010 D-FNQ and q0011 D-FL16. (1) Close both (nrpic-run finish accepts runs continued in place) and judge them against their predictions with registered analyses and figures you look at: Q1 to Q3 and XQ; L1 to L5 (L3 with Delta M from 20 M). (2) The three-way convergence of item C2: particle number (N/4, N, 4N) and the mesh of the growth (M/8, M/16, with M/4 labelled outside the convergent regime: ruling 0039 item 4); horizon numbers labelled 'made without the diagnostics' and rechecked by the failure signature as in batch 20. (3) The G2 package item by item. If what remains open is only failures on record with their rulings and the fresh verifier of the whole gate: write the G2 sections of the note (v3), the schematics on the release, the rerun script's list, run nrpic-stage collect, verify and report, and list G2 in gates_complete so that the verifier and the gate review can be sent; otherwise say which run each open item waits for, and queue it (priority 2, prediction first, <fastflow> diagnostics = true in new runs).
